@NullMarked public class LogEventsAssert extends org.assertj.core.api.AbstractListAssert<LogEventsAssert, List<nl.altindag.log.model.LogEvent>, nl.altindag.log.model.LogEvent, LogEventAssert>
An assertion class for a list of LogEvents.

This class provides methods to assert various conditions on a list of LogEvents. It extends AbstractAssert from AssertJ to provide fluent assertions.

    • filteredByMessage

      @FormatMethod public LogEventsAssert filteredByMessage(BiPredicate<String,String> matcher, @FormatString String expected, Object... args)
      Filters the log events that have a message matching the given matcher.

      Note: If no log events match the expectation, the returned LogEventsAssert will be empty but not fail.

      Example usage: 

      .withMessage(String::contains, "Expected message")
      Parameters:
      matcher - The matcher to apply to the log event messages.
      expected - The expected message to match against.
      args - The optional arguments to format the expected message.
      Returns:
      A new LogEventsAssert containing the log events that match the expectation. This may be empty.

    • hasAnyWithMessage

      @FormatMethod public LogEventsAssert hasAnyWithMessage(BiPredicate<String,String> matcher, @FormatString String expected, Object... args)
      Verifies that at least one log event has a message that matches the given matcher.

      This method is similar to filteredByMessage(BiPredicate, String, Object...) but asserts that the result is not empty.

      Example usage: 

      .hasAnyWithMessage(String::startsWith, "Expected message")
      Parameters:
      matcher - The matcher to apply to the log event messages.
      expected - The expected message to match against.
      args - The optional arguments to format the expected message.
      Returns:
      A new LogEventsAssert containing the log events that match the expectation. This is never empty.

      @FormatMethod public LogEventAssert singleWithMessage(BiPredicate<String,String> matcher, @FormatString String expected, Object... args)

      Parameters:
